last.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook a second time, while controlling owner LS Power's $2.00-a-share cash buyout offer now frames the stock.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook fell to $375-400M from $400-430M. The adjusted EBITDA loss is now expected at $15-30M, versus a $5-25M loss in August.

takeaways.label: Buyout offer
takeaways.text: LS Power, the controlling shareholder, offered $2.00 cash per share on November 2. The offer is unsolicited and non-binding. An independent board committee is reviewing it, and no decision has been made.

takeaways.label: Charging up, total flat
takeaways.text: Charging revenue grew 29% to $72M, but total revenue slipped 1% to $91.4M. Revenue from building chargers for partners (eXtend) fell 49%.

takeaways.label: Cash and losses worsening
takeaways.text: Net loss widened to $49.2M from $28.4M. Cash fell to $98.7M from $151M at year-end, and debt rose to about $317M from about $207M.

history.verdict: Investors sold EVgo after the company cut its full-year outlook and cash burn rose.

reasons.label: Lower 2026 outlook
reasons.text: Revenue guidance cut to $400-430M from $410-470M; below analysts' roughly $433M.

reasons.label: Bigger expected losses
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EBITDA now a $5-25M loss, versus a range reaching up to +$20M before.

reasons.label: Cash and slower ramp
reasons.text: Operating cash burn widened and new stalls ramped slower than hoped, despite Tesla deal.
